ex.en: The picnic was called off because of the rain.
ex.zh: 野餐因為下雨取消了。

ex.en: A warm, sunny day is ideal for a picnic.
ex.zh: 溫暖晴朗的日子最適合野餐。

ex.en: If it's fine tomorrow, we'll go on a picnic.
ex.zh: 如果明天天氣好，我們就去野餐。

ex.en: How many different kinds of pizzas are on the menu?
ex.zh: 菜單上有幾種披薩？

ex.en: The pizza delivery guy hasn't come by yet.
ex.zh: 送披薩的人還沒來。

ex.en: I don't understand why pepperoni pizza is so popular.
ex.zh: 我不懂為什麼義式臘腸披薩這麼受歡迎。

ex.en: Can I have a piece of this apple pie?
ex.zh: 我可以吃一塊蘋果派嗎？

ex.en: My mother often bakes apple pies for us.
ex.zh: 媽媽常常烤蘋果派給我們吃。

ex.en: Will you have another slice of pie?
ex.zh: 你要再來一塊派嗎？

ex.en: The pie chart shows our market share.
ex.zh: 這張圓餅圖顯示我們的市占率。

ex.en: Let's use a pie chart for this data.
ex.zh: 這些數據我們用圓餅圖呈現吧。

ex.en: She sleeps with two pillows.
ex.zh: 她睡覺用兩個枕頭。

ex.en: Could I have a pillow and blanket?
ex.zh: 可以給我一個枕頭和一條毯子嗎？

ex.en: Please bring me the pillow and the blanket.
ex.zh: 請把枕頭和毯子拿給我。

ex.en: The gas pipeline runs under the sea.
ex.zh: 天然氣管線從海底穿過。

ex.en: Workers are repairing a broken pipeline.
ex.zh: 工人正在修理破裂的管線。

pipeline.zh: in the pipeline：籌備中、進行中

ex.en: We have several new products in the pipeline.
ex.zh: 我們有好幾項新產品正在籌備中。

ex.en: More changes are in the pipeline.
ex.zh: 更多改變正在醞釀中。

ex.en: She was a pioneer in the field of computer science.
ex.zh: 她是電腦科學領域的先驅。

ex.en: The company is a pioneer in electric cars.
ex.zh: 這家公司是電動車的先驅。

ex.en: He did pioneering work in the field of physical geography.
ex.zh: 他在自然地理學領域做了開創性的研究。

ex.en: This bank pioneered online banking in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這家銀行率先在台灣推出網路銀行。

ex.en: It was so still that you would have heard a pin drop.
ex.zh: 安靜到連一根針掉在地上都聽得到。

ex.en: She attached the note to the board with a pin.
ex.zh: 她用圖釘把便條釘在板子上。

ex.en: He pinned the badge on his vest.
ex.zh: 他把徽章別在背心上。

ex.en: Please pin the notice on the bulletin board.
ex.zh: 請把公告釘在布告欄上。

ex.en: Please enter your PIN.
ex.zh: 請輸入您的密碼。

ex.en: Never share your PIN with anyone.
ex.zh: 絕對不要把密碼告訴任何人。

ex.en: We need to pin down a date for the meeting.
ex.zh: 我們需要敲定開會的日期。

ex.en: It's hard to pin down the exact cause.
ex.zh: 很難確定確切的原因。

ex.en: I dug a huge pit with my shovel in just one day.
ex.zh: 我只花一天就用鏟子挖了一個大坑。

ex.en: Workers dug a deep pit for the foundation.
ex.zh: 工人為地基挖了一個深坑。

ex.en: Remove the pits from the cherries.
ex.zh: 把櫻桃的籽去掉。

ex.en: This avocado has a huge pit.
ex.zh: 這顆酪梨的籽很大。

pit.zh: 使對抗、使競爭（pit A against B）

ex.en: The game pits two teams against each other.
ex.zh: 這場比賽讓兩隊互相較勁。

ex.en: The contest pits young designers against experienced ones.
ex.zh: 這場比賽讓年輕設計師和資深設計師同台競爭。

ex.en: These pictures always remind me of the old days.
ex.zh: 這些照片總是讓我想起從前。

ex.en: Let me see the pictures you took in Paris.
ex.zh: 讓我看看你在巴黎拍的照片吧。

ex.en: The frame itself is worth more than the picture.
ex.zh: 畫框本身比畫還值錢。

ex.en: When I saw the picture, I remembered the story.
ex.zh: 我一看到那幅畫，就想起了那個故事。

ex.en: This report gives a clear picture of our sales.
ex.zh: 這份報告清楚呈現了我們的銷售狀況。

ex.en: Let me give you the big picture first.
ex.zh: 我先跟你說明整體情況。

ex.en: I can't picture him as a manager.
ex.zh: 我無法想像他當經理的樣子。

ex.en: Picture yourself on a beach in Bali.
ex.zh: 想像你自己在峇里島的海灘上。

ex.en: Please pick me up at the airport at five.
ex.zh: 請五點到機場接我。

ex.en: Are you picking me up at 7 tomorrow morning?
ex.zh: 你明天早上七點來接我嗎？

ex.en: I'll pick you up at your home at five.
ex.zh: 我五點去你家接你。

ex.en: I picked out a new hat at the store.
ex.zh: 我在店裡挑了一頂新帽子。

ex.en: Pick any seat you like.
ex.zh: 隨便挑你喜歡的位子坐。

ex.en: We picked strawberries on the farm.
ex.zh: 我們在農場採草莓。

ex.en: Please don't pick the flowers in the park.
ex.zh: 請不要摘公園裡的花。

ex.en: He picked up a mirror and examined his tongue.
ex.zh: 他拿起一面鏡子，仔細看自己的舌頭。

ex.en: Can you pick up that box for me?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我把那個箱子拿起來嗎？

ex.en: I hope the economy picks up soon.
ex.zh: 我希望經濟很快好轉。

ex.en: Sales usually pick up before Christmas.
ex.zh: 銷售通常在聖誕節前好轉。

ex.en: The boy reached out for another piece of cake.
ex.zh: 男孩伸手又拿了一塊蛋糕。

ex.en: He threw a piece of meat to a dog.
ex.zh: 他丟了一塊肉給狗。

ex.en: How many pieces of baggage do you have?
ex.zh: 請問您有幾件行李？

ex.en: Cutting a cake into equal pieces is rather difficult.
ex.zh: 把蛋糕切成一樣大的塊相當困難。

ex.en: The glass broke into a hundred pieces.
ex.zh: 玻璃碎成好多片。

ex.en: He practiced the piece many times before the concert.
ex.zh: 他在音樂會前把這首曲子練了很多次。

ex.en: This piece was painted in 1890.
ex.zh: 這幅作品是 1890 年畫的。

piece.zh: a piece of advice / information：一則建議／資訊

ex.en: Let me give you a piece of advice.
ex.zh: 讓我給你一個建議。

ex.en: That's a useful piece of information.
ex.zh: 那是很有用的資訊。

ex.en: I want to be a pilot in the future.
ex.zh: 我將來想當飛行員。

ex.en: Pilots communicate with the airport by radio.
ex.zh: 飛行員用無線電和機場聯絡。

ex.en: Tom and Mary are both helicopter pilots.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗都是直升機駕駛員。

ex.en: We will run a pilot program in three stores.
ex.zh: 我們將在三家店推行試辦計畫。

ex.en: The pilot project was a big success.
ex.zh: 這個試行專案非常成功。

ex.en: The school is piloting a new English course.
ex.zh: 學校正在試辦一門新的英文課程。

ex.en: The system was piloted in two offices first.
ex.zh: 這套系統先在兩間辦公室試行。

ex.en: This is a good place to pitch a tent.
ex.zh: 這裡很適合搭帳篷。

ex.en: They were looking for a place at which they could pitch the tent.
ex.zh: 他們在找可以搭帳篷的地方。

ex.en: We have ten minutes to pitch our idea to investors.
ex.zh: 我們有十分鐘向投資人推銷我們的構想。

ex.en: She pitched the new product to three clients.
ex.zh: 她向三位客戶推銷這項新產品。

ex.en: She gave a great sales pitch to the client.
ex.zh: 她向客戶做了一場很棒的推銷。

ex.en: His pitch was short but convincing.
ex.zh: 他的提案簡短但很有說服力。

pitch.zh: pitch black / pitch dark：漆黑一片

ex.en: It's pitch black outside.
ex.zh: 外面一片漆黑。

ex.en: It is pitch dark.
ex.zh: 天色一片漆黑。

ex.en: The rose is pink.
ex.zh: 這朵玫瑰是粉紅色的。

ex.en: My notebook is pink.
ex.zh: 我的筆記本是粉紅色的。

ex.en: Who is the woman dressed in pink?
ex.zh: 那位穿粉紅色衣服的女士是誰？

ex.en: Pink is my favorite color.
ex.zh: 粉紅色是我最喜歡的顏色。

ex.en: He donated a large pile of items to the museum.
ex.zh: 他把一大堆物品捐給了博物館。

ex.en: There was a neat pile of books in the corner of the room.
ex.zh: 房間角落整齊地放著一疊書。

ex.en: There's a pile of documents on my desk.
ex.zh: 我桌上有一疊文件。

pile.zh: 堆積、堆放（常作 pile up）

ex.en: The luggage is piled up in the truck.
ex.zh: 行李堆放在卡車上。

ex.en: The trash is really starting to pile up.
ex.zh: 垃圾真的開始越堆越多了。

ex.en: The emails piled up while I was on vacation.
ex.zh: 我休假期間，電子郵件越積越多。

ex.en: In her home, kitchen garbage was fed to the pigs.
ex.zh: 在她家，廚餘都拿去餵豬。

ex.en: Pigs share certain characteristics with human beings.
ex.zh: 豬和人類有某些共同特徵。

ex.en: The farmer raises pigs and chickens.
ex.zh: 那位農夫養豬和雞。

ex.en: I pigged out on pizza.
ex.zh: 我狂吃了一頓披薩。

ex.en: We pigged out on snacks during the movie.
ex.zh: 我們看電影時狂吃零食。

ex.en: Something is stuck in the pipe.
ex.zh: 有東西卡在管子裡。

ex.en: The water pipes froze and then burst.
ex.zh: 水管結冰後爆裂了。

ex.en: A pipe burst in the office bathroom.
ex.zh: 辦公室廁所的水管爆了。

ex.en: Grandfather talked to me with a pipe in his mouth.
ex.zh: 爺爺叼著菸斗跟我說話。

ex.en: He was sitting there with a pipe in his mouth.
ex.zh: 他嘴裡叼著菸斗坐在那裡。

ex.en: She spends a lot of time practicing the piano.
ex.zh: 她花很多時間練鋼琴。

ex.en: Could you teach me how to play the piano?
ex.zh: 您可以教我彈鋼琴嗎？

ex.en: He was playing the piano and she was singing.
ex.zh: 他彈鋼琴，她唱歌。

ex.en: Pi is approximately 3.14.
ex.zh: 圓周率約等於 3.14。

ex.en: Use pi to calculate the area of a circle.
ex.zh: 用圓周率來計算圓的面積。

ex.en: Thousands of people make a pilgrimage to the temple every year.
ex.zh: 每年有數千人到那座寺廟朝聖。

ex.en: She went on a pilgrimage to Spain.
ex.zh: 她到西班牙進行了一趟朝聖之旅。

ex.en: Fans make a pilgrimage to the singer's hometown.
ex.zh: 粉絲專程造訪那位歌手的家鄉。

ex.en: For coffee lovers, this café is a pilgrimage site.
ex.zh: 對咖啡愛好者來說，這家咖啡館是朝聖之地。

ex.en: Before going to bed, I took three pills to stop a cold.
ex.zh: 睡前我吃了三顆感冒藥。

ex.en: Why does Tom take those pills?
ex.zh: 湯姆為什麼要吃那些藥？

ex.en: These pills act on the heart.
ex.zh: 這些藥對心臟有作用。

ex.en: It is a pity that you can't join us.
ex.zh: 你不能和我們一起來真可惜。

ex.en: It's a pity you don't know how to dance!
ex.zh: 可惜你不知道如何跳舞！

ex.en: It's a pity you didn't come last night.
ex.zh: 您昨晚沒來真是太可惜了！

ex.en: Much as I pitied him, I could not help him.
ex.zh: 雖然我很同情他，但卻幫不上忙。

ex.en: I pity anyone who has to work with him.
ex.zh: 我同情任何得跟他共事的人。

ex.en: I have pimples.
ex.zh: 我長痘痘了。

ex.en: On his nose grew a small pimple.
ex.zh: 他的鼻子上長了一顆小痘痘。

ex.en: Try not to squeeze your pimples, or they may leave scars.
ex.zh: 盡量別擠青春痘，不然可能會留疤。

ex.en: Workers picketed outside the factory for better pay.
ex.zh: 工人們在工廠外設糾察線，要求更好的待遇。

ex.en: The nurses picketed the hospital to protest long working hours.
ex.zh: 護理師們在醫院外抗議工時過長。

ex.en: The pickets held signs and chanted outside the gate.
ex.zh: 糾察隊員們在大門外舉著標語喊口號。

ex.en: Some employees refused to cross the picket line.
ex.zh: 有些員工拒絕越過罷工糾察線去上班。

ex.en: There are two things in the world that cannot wait: 1. Filial piety, 2. Doing good.
ex.zh: 世上有兩件事不能等：一、孝順 二、行善。

ex.en: Filial piety is an important value in many Asian families.
ex.zh: 孝道是許多亞洲家庭重視的價值觀。

ex.en: The old woman was known for her piety and kindness.
ex.zh: 那位老婦人以虔誠和善良聞名。

ex.en: My grandmother is a pious woman who prays every morning.
ex.zh: 我奶奶是個虔誠的人，每天早上都會禱告。

ex.en: The pious villagers gathered at the temple for the festival.
ex.zh: 虔誠的村民們聚集在廟裡參加慶典。

ex.en: Each pixel on the screen can display millions of colors.
ex.zh: 螢幕上的每個像素都能顯示數百萬種顏色。

ex.en: The image became blurry when enlarged beyond its pixel limit.
ex.zh: 圖片放大超過像素限制後就變模糊了。

ex.en: The new pillar supports the roof of the warehouse.
ex.zh: 這根新柱子支撐著倉庫屋頂。

ex.en: Workers reinforced the concrete pillar near the entrance.
ex.zh: 工人加固了入口附近的混凝土柱。

ex.en: The ferry leaves from the pier beside the harbor office.
ex.zh: 渡輪從港務辦公室旁的碼頭出發。

ex.en: A new pier will give the marina room for larger boats.
ex.zh: 新建的棧橋將讓遊艇港能停靠更大的船。

ex.en: Naples is a picturesque city.
ex.zh: 那不勒斯是一個風景如畫的城市。

ex.en: We stayed in a picturesque village by the lake.
ex.zh: 我們住在湖邊一個風景如畫的小村莊。

ex.en: Look out for pickpockets.
ex.zh: 小心扒手。

ex.en: Some brave passengers caught the pickpocket and turned him over to the police.
ex.zh: 幾位勇敢的乘客抓住了扒手，把他交給警察。

ex.en: Beware of pickpockets here.
ex.zh: 這裡要小心扒手。
